avis.texte: wanted to love this because I love the green cerva ve moisturizing wash, but it had cancer causing ingredients. This "cleanser feels like a soapy and wash. Leaves my skin feeling more dry than when it started. When I recommend this at all.

I discovered the face wash is seaping out the bottom of the bottle. I was using Naturium Vitamin C Complex Cleanser. I may return this CeraVe Face wash since their products contain cancerous chemicals like Benzene.

avis.titre: Wanted to love it but not for me
avis.texte: I used this for about a week and it left my face feeling very tight/stripped, and definitely began irritating my skin barrier. The texture is for sure more of a gel than a true oil, but the lather is very nice. Just a warning to those with dry sensitive skin!

I was on a journey to find a new cleanser for my really dry sensitive skin. I just went through all the samples my dermatologist gave me with no success. I went to buy the *best* of the samples and saw this right next to it and went for it since it was for even drier skin types. WOW! loved the texture, a little goes a long way, and the top locks so I can take it in my gym bag too. Love it!

avis.titre: This is not an oil cleanser
avis.texte: I rarely review, but this is not an oil cleanser. It is packaged to look like an oul but it is a regular run of the mill cleansing gel in a light yellow bottle. Surprise! Dries my skin out and I need an oil cleanser still.

avis.titre: Saved my skin! BEST hybrid cleanser EVER!
avis.texte: I never write reviews but I just had to share. I've repurchased this product multiple times now. When I first started using this product my dry, sensitive, acne prone skin with rosacea was in full disarray. In my 30s and I've tried everything. I credit this product to healing my skin barrier over the past few months. I use it as a double cleanser and cleanser (wash my face twice) when wearing makeup. Once when wearing no makeup. Then right after the shower I follow up with a hydrating toner, milky toner, eye cream, and moisturizer. Day time I add sunscreen, night I use a gentle AHA serum. My partner's combo, acne prone skin has also dramatically improved as well! I would say this a great starting cleanser for any skin type. Any age. It's not an oil cleanser, but rather more like a water consistency. If you're wanting a true oil cleanser/cleansing balm, look elsewhere. That's probably why anyone would dislike this. My skin went through a "purging" phase in the beginning because my skin was so dehydrated and congested. Expect some temporary acne if you have a similar skin type. Push through and I promise it's worth it. CeraVe please never discontinue this!!

avis.titre: I would re buy this forever
avis.texte: This took off my makeup without anything else and made my skin super soft over time, definitely worth your money

This is more of a traditional soapy cleanser than an oil cleanser. I am 36 and have normal-dry skin, it leaves my skin feeling tight and uncomfortable after washing and I feel that I need to scrub a bit more than I'd like to get my skin clean. Works great for brushes., may be good for oilier skin.

I have been trying to replace my beloved, discontinued Eucerin Skin Calming Body Wash (a soybean oil based oil cleanser), and this is one of the many products I have tried. This is not an oil cleanser. It does not have an oily consistency, but something like a thin gel consistency. Skinfix has something similar (although a lot more expensive). So does Naturium. This cleanser is VERY stripping and drying and dehydrating if you are used to a true oil cleanser. So disappointed in Cerave (and so many other brands) for calling a stripping gel cleanser an oil cleanser. I will say, this isn't a bad product if you are looking for a normal gel cleanser. For someone with sensitive, easily stripped, dehydrated skin, this is highly disappointing and not what was advertised.
This is a strange product. It says "foaming oil cleanser" and "water based face wash." I was thinking it would be more of a liquid cleansing balm/oil. It isn't. So I thought id share/

I'm a regular user of oil cleansers; they've improved my skin so much since turning 40. Looking for a more economical option, I tried this, but was disappointed. "Foaming" should have tipped me off that there is a surfactant (soap) in this, but I didn't make the connection right away. My skin wasn't a disaster after using this, but it was dryer and tighter than I like and didn't feel very clean; my skin looked dull and kind of filmy as well. I'll be returning it.

avis.titre: Great product for my combo skin!
avis.texte: I personally really like this cleanser, and it seems to work really well on my acne prone oily/combo skin. Some people in other reviews have complained it's not a true oil cleanser. While I do agree that it's more water based and not a full on oil, it is much more gentle on the skin than other foaming face washes because it does have some oil in it. It's almost like an oily soap? I like this because I think an actual oil cleanser would break me out. My face gets so dry in the winter to the point I am unable to use my acne wash (Panoxyl and La Roshe) as often, so I started using this and it's helped with my dryness so much and didn't cause me to breakout more. I break out very very easily too. If you have combo skin this is perfect for maintaining hydration on dry spots and getting rid of excess oil on oiler spots.

avis.titre: You get what you pay for!
avis.texte: My parents used to say, "You get what you pay for". This was sticky, gooey, not refreshing at all and made my skin feel dry and unclean. With everything going up, up and up i thought I'd try something less costly but even this was too much money for what I feel was lower quality. We deserve better people!

avis.titre: Very good product for aging skin
avis.texte: I am on my third bottle of this. I like to use this to wash my makeup off at night. It never leaves my skin dry and flaky and it gets the job done. It lathers nicely and makes my face feel smooth and clean afterwards.

I ran out of my usual facial cleanser (Vanicream) and decided to try this one out. Unfortunately, it didn't work for me. The liquid is very thin and did not foam well, so I felt like I needed to use more to cover my face. Immediately after rinsing, my face felt tight. It didn't not feel hydrating at all to me. I gave it an extra star because the scent is inoffensive and it seemed to clean well, but I won't repurchase. Back to my trusty Vanicream.

avis.titre: I've repurchased this at least 4 times

This is a product I will be using ..on going..please provide me a sale price next time

I do like this product, I use it to take off makeup prior to using my normal cleanser. However, this is not an oil cleanser. It's basically their foaming cleanser, but not as drying. If you're looking for a true oil cleanser this isn't it. It does the job, I'll definitely use it up but I won't repurchase.

I love this face wash. It removes all of my makeup without drying my face out. I have combination skin with some dryness/flaky skin around my nose and chin area. This does not seem to dry it out as bad as some others.
I have used cleaneers at all price points. I am obsessed with this face wash. This product has worked to repair my skin barrier by lessening the redness.

I love this cleanser. It's gentle but effective. It works so well!!! I had my daughter start using it as well and noticed a huge difference right away. Would highly recommend this to anyone to use as daily cleanser.

The best face cleanser yet!! This is an oil based formula that turns to foaming when wet. I love to use this as part of a double cleanse after removing makeup with a balm or micellar water. It takes off EVERYTHING- full coverage foundation, cream products, and waterproof mascara. Yet it's gentle enough that there is no tugging while cleansing and no tightness once your face is dry. Leaves the skin feeling clean and smooth. I can't rate this highly enough!! Works wonders for my combo dry skin and I think it could work for all skin types. Is affordable and available on Amazon and mass retailers.

avis.titre: Not sure how I feel about it yet

i bought this because i saw that it says its an oil cleanser and its hydrating. it also looks oily in the container. background, i have oil skin. i like a japanese oil cleanser cause it removes all my makeup. regular oil cleansers look and feel oily when applied on dry skin and then once water is applied it gets milky or foamy. this cleanser doesnt even have the oil texture when you apply it on dry skin. it just gets sticky like a regular cleanser. once you add water it does foam up but once i rinse and pat dry my skin feels SO DEHYDRATED and tight. it also didnt remove all my makeup like a typical oil cleanser. literally only 1/3 of the claims is accurate which is the foaming aspect. i dont recommend. try a different oil cleanser and youll see a remarkable difference in hydration as well as its ability to remove all your makeup
Perfect combination gentle and effective. Not drying, no residue, just like it says. Cerave—please don't change it!

avis.titre: Effectiveness of clearing skin from dirt and buildup
avis.texte: I love that this product is an oil cleanser but also foams, the texture it leaves my skin is very nice and hydrated. The ingredients of this product are definitely up to my standards. This oil cleanser is best used in my opinion in the morning.

avis.titre: Cleanses the skin well after SPF and moisturizes the skin.
avis.texte: "This hydrating cleansing oil foam is a true discovery in my daily skincare routine! It does an amazing job of removing sunscreen residue after a full day out in the sun. You know how it is - by the end of the day, your skin can feel clogged and you're left with whitish streaks from the SPF. But just a small amount of this gentle cleansing formula transforms into a luxurious lather that works its magic. The oil texture literally melts away all the built-up sebum, impurities, and makeup remnants, yet it never strips or overdries the skin. The foam is surprisingly gentle, but deeply purifying for the pores. After using it, my complexion looks fresh, smooth, and radiant, without the slightest hint of tightness or dryness. Moreover, this formula somehow manages to maintain the skin's natural moisture balance, leaving it hydrated and nourished. The scent is also lovely - a soothing, floral-herbal bouquet that creates a true sense of an at-home spa experience. Using it is pure bliss, and my skin feels velvety soft to the touch. In short, I'm completely satisfied with this discovery! I've finally found the perfect cleansing formula that doesn't just remove makeup, but deeply cares for the skin as well. I highly recommend giving it a try!"

avis.titre: I've wanted a product like this for so long!
avis.texte: This is perfect for me. Ive been looking for an oil cleanser that foams for a while and I was so happy to see this from Cerave, a brand I trust to be gentle and effective on my skin. I use it as a morning cleanser to remove all of my heavier night cream residue. It does remove light face makeup (not great with mascara) but I prefer to use a traditional oil cleanser to remove makeup. LOVE THIS and I hope they never discontinue. I'll alwys stock up when it goes on sale.

This cleanser makes me look forward to washing my face. I am in my early 50's and my face has become increasingly dry. I had been using Cereve Cream Cleanser and switched to the oil cleanser. I am in love. This cleanser is so lux.

avis.titre: The PERFECT cleanser for dry skin!

I like the ingredients so I leave it on my face for at least a minute while I brush my teeth. This cleanser is so gentle on my mature skin. It did not leave me feeling dry or irritated. Would highly recommend for anyone. I'm 58 and have combination skin.

I highly recommend this cleanser even to those with oily skin.

I'm so glad that I purchased the CeraVe hydrating foaming oil cleanser. I was influenced to purchase this cleansing oil from a dermatologist on YouTube. This is a very effective cleansing oil that removes all my makeup, including waterproof mascara and sunscreen. I like to do a double cleanse in the evening. The texture of this cleansing oil feels very soothing. This cleanser will foam once added with water. I like to give my face a gentle massage, working the oil into my skin, effectively removing the multiple layers of sunscreen, face primer, liquid foundation, blush, bronzer, contour, highlighter, liquid eyeliner, liquid and powder eyeshadow, eyeshadow primer, and mascara, plus setting spray. This is a phenomenal cleansing oil. You get a lot of product for the price. This bottle has lasted me so long, and I'm not even halfway through it yet. I highly recommend this cleansing oil. I do not notice any kind of scent. I think this would work great with sensitive skin. This is perfect for my dry combination skin type.
I purcahsed this November 2023 and it has not helped me, actually I feel like it has made my skin more dry , especially near my eyes.
This wash removes makeup but does dry your skin a bit. I just use a moisturizer immediately after.
Really enjoy this face wash. It's nice on my skin and does not dry me out.

avis.titre: I will keep buying this cleanser

avis.texte: You don't even need to purchase this to know its not a real oil cleanser. If you look on the ingredients list, the first ingredient is water. It feels like a thin gel cleanser. I should have looked at the ingredients... This isn't an oil cleanser but normal soap, very misleading. This needs water to foam up and be used; proper oil cleansers, by contrast, can be rubbed in for a long time and rinse off with hot water. As a result this is very drying and doesn't bond to the dirt in my pores (sebaceous filaments). For a proper oil cleanser I would get the Mario Badescu cleansing oil, Burt's bees cleansing oil or even Neutrogena makeup removing oil.
This right here! The best facial cleanser to date. Even without moisturizing this makes my face feel amazing. Highly recommend.
